newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian boys murder girl, abuse body.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian boys murder girl, abuse body.

text.p: Three Brazilian boys drowned a 10-year-old girl in a lake and then sexually abused her body with a broomstick, police said on Tuesday.

The boys, aged 9, 10 and 13, confessed to drowning Isis de Souza two weeks ago and abusing her body at a lake outside Vitoria, capital of the central coastal state of Espirito Santo, a police spokeswoman said.
The 13-year-old boy was sent to a youth detention centre. The other two were released to their parents and will be required to undergo psychological counselling, police said.
